comment: Golden vectors for firmware-command-result/v1. A receiver must accept every 'results' case whose expect is accept and refuse every other with its declared reason, judging each on its own against verifier_context. 'digests', 'judgments' and 'lifecycle' fix the command digest, the device's duplicate table and the runtime's conclusions. Signed with disclosed TEST-ONLY seeds: never provision them.

reasons.member_set: a member the contract does not define, or a required one missing
reasons.unknown_kind: kind is not one of the six kinds
reasons.outcome_not_allowed: outcome is not one its kind allows
reasons.digest_form: command_digest is not sha256: and 64 lowercase hex digits
reasons.family_keys: the payload carries more than one family key beside signature
